clips.title: The story
paras: Along eastern Silverpine, Shining Strand follows Lordamere Lake south from the Ruins of Lordaeron toward Alterac's rugged foothills. Vile Fin murlocs hold settlements in its shallows, making the shore dangerous for unseasoned travelers.

Shining Strand follows Silverpine Forest's eastern edge beside the misty waters of Lordamere Lake. Several aggressive Vile Fin murloc settlements line the shallows, threatening anyone who travels the lake road. Feral worgen roam the deep woods behind the shore.
